name: Puerto Vallarta International Airport

runway.v: one runway 04-22, 3,100 m x 45 m, asphalt
runway.quote: It has a runway of 3,100 meters long and 45 meters wide with 04-22 designation.

handling.v: private aviation FBO Aerotron, inside the airport (separate general aviation terminal)
handling.quote: Aerotron se encuentra localizado dentro de las instalaciones del propio aeropuerto

fuel.v: avgas and Jet A by truck
fuel.quote: los camiones Gas avión y Jet A

notes: IATA PVR and ICAO MMPR from GAP's 'About the airport' page. Operator GAP. Mexico AIP AD 2 MMPR (aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx) not found by search and earlier runs found the site refuses automated reading. Airport tariff rules (Aeropuerto de Puerto Vallarta, DOF notice 15 Mar 2022, read via sidof.segob.gob.mx/notas/docFuente/5647413) say operating hours are those in the AIP and services outside them carry a 100% surcharge; no hours given, so not recorded. DOF page https://dof.gob.mx/nota_detalle.php?codigo=5763617&fecha=23%2F07%2F2025 refused (robots). Airport is in Jalisco (Central time, no DST).
